blind.description: A tall, stylized brick chimney stack featuring tan stone corner quoins framing a central column of reddish-brown bricks. The top is crowned with a projecting stone cornice slab supporting three terracotta chimney pots: two outer hexagonal pots and a central square pot with dark interior openings. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous with hand-painted stylized textures. It stands upright on its flat base without any auxiliary plinth.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular cream-coloured top slab divided into three joined sections, bearing three hollow chimney pots in a row (two hexagonal openings flanking a square central opening with dark hollow cavities).
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.5 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 8.5 to 9 feet tall), and about 2.5 feet wide by 1 foot deep.
